onderdelen.title: Parts
onderdelen.intro: New original spare parts. Search by name or number, or pick your car and browse by category.
onderdelen.about: CarO sells new parts for passenger cars and two-wheelers: brake discs and pads, filters, suspension, cooling, lighting and electrics. Enter your registration or pick make, model and version — the catalogue then shows only the articles that fit your car. Searching by name or OE number works without a car too. All prices include 21% Dutch VAT and you have fourteen days to change your mind.

q1.question: Will these parts fit my car?
q1.answer: First enter your registration or pick make, model and version. The catalogue then shows only parts that fit that particular version — a 1.0 TSI with 70 kW takes different brakes from the same car with 85 kW, so the version really matters.

q2.question: Can I search by OE number?
q2.answer: Yes. Type the number into the search field; a partial number works too. The prefix OEN searches OE numbers only, EAN searches barcodes only. Searching by name works as well, but keep it to a single word: a description of several words returns nothing at the supplier.

q3.question: Are the parts new?
q3.answer: Yes, all new and from the manufacturers our wholesaler carries. CarO sells no used parts, and nothing for trucks, agriculture or industry.

banden.title: Tyres
banden.intro: Tyres for cars, SUVs, vans and two-wheelers.
banden.about: Summer, winter and all-season tyres for cars, SUVs, vans and two-wheelers. Enter the size printed on the sidewall of your current tyre — width, height and rim diameter, for example 205/55 R16 — and narrow it down by season if you like. You get the range of hundreds of brands, with prices including 21% Dutch VAT.

q1.question: Where do I find my tyre size?
q1.answer: On the sidewall of your current tyre, written as 205/55 R16: 205 is the width in millimetres, 55 the height as a percentage of that width, and 16 the rim diameter in inches. Those three numbers go into the picker above.

q2.question: Summer, winter or all-season — which do I pick?
q2.answer: Summer tyres stop shortest on dry and wet roads above roughly seven degrees. Winter tyres stay supple below that and grip in snow. All-season tyres sit in between: one set all year, with a little less grip at both extremes.

q3.question: Can I search for tyres by registration?
q3.answer: No. There is no reliable route from a Dutch registration number to a tyre size — not even in the RDW open data. We would rather not guess about that, so enter the size printed on your tyre.

velgen.title: Wheels
velgen.intro: Steel wheels in all common sizes.
velgen.about: Steel wheels in every common size. Filter by bolt pattern, rim size, offset and load rating; those figures are stamped on the inside of your current wheel. Prices include 21% Dutch VAT and you have fourteen days to change your mind.

q1.question: Which wheel size fits my car?
q1.answer: That depends on the bolt pattern (the number of bolts and their circle diameter), the rim size and the offset. Those figures are usually stamped on the inside of your current wheel. Filter on them above, and check the measurements before you order.

q2.question: What does ET mean?
q2.answer: ET is the offset in millimetres: the distance between the wheel's mounting face and the centre line of the rim width. A different ET pushes the wheel further out or in, and can rub against the suspension or the arch.

q3.question: Are these steel or alloy wheels?
q3.answer: Steel wheels for now. They are cheaper and stand up better to kerbs and road salt, which makes them the usual choice for a winter set. Alloy wheels join the range later.

toebehoren.title: Accessories
toebehoren.intro: Wheel and tyre accessories, from valves to storage systems.
toebehoren.about: Wheel and tyre accessories and car equipment: valves, wheel nuts, snow chains, storage systems, batteries, lighting, oils and car care. Filter by brand, size, colour or material. Prices include 21% Dutch VAT.

q1.question: What counts as accessories?
q1.answer: Everything around the wheel and the car itself: valves, wheel nuts and snow chains, but also batteries and chargers, lighting, oils and lubricants, car care and fasteners.

q2.question: Do snow chains fit every tyre?
q2.answer: No, chains are tied to a tyre size. That size is listed with the item — compare it with the size on your sidewall. Mind the clearance in the wheel arch too; not every car is suitable for chains.

q3.question: Can I filter these for my own car?
q3.answer: For accessories we search the supplier's description for make and model. That is a strong indication, not a guarantee: always check the size or type listed with the item.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply to every order placed with CarO. They are written for consumers and follow Dutch consumer law (Books 6 and 7 of the Civil Code) and the European rules on distance selling.

identity.title: Who we are
identity.body: CarO sells car parts, tyres, wheels and accessories to consumers in the Netherlands. Our contact details and registration numbers appear at the bottom of every page.

scope.title: What these terms cover
scope.body: Every offer in this shop and every agreement that follows from it. If you and we agree to depart from these terms, we record that in writing.

offer.title: Offers and orders
offer.body: An offer applies while stock lasts. We fetch stock and prices live from our supplier, but an item can still sell out between your order and our purchase. If that happens we tell you and refund the amount. An agreement is formed once we confirm your order.

prices.title: Prices
prices.body: All prices shown include 21% VAT. Obvious mistakes and typing errors do not bind us: if a price is clearly wrong, we may cancel the order and refund you in full.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: You pay in advance using the methods shown at checkout. Your order ships once payment has been received.

delivery.title: Delivery and shipping costs
delivery.body: We ship within the Netherlands via PostNL, DHL or DPD. Shipping costs {shipping} and is free on orders from {freeFrom}. We aim to deliver within thirty days; if we cannot, we will tell you and you may cancel free of charge. The risk of damage or loss rests with us until you receive the parcel.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.body: You may cancel your order within fourteen days of receipt without giving a reason, and then have another fourteen days to return it. We refund within fourteen days of your notice. Parts that have been fitted, or whose seal has been broken, cannot be taken back. Return shipping is at your expense unless the item was delivered wrongly or damaged.

conformity.title: Warranty and conformity
conformity.body: Every item must do what you may reasonably expect of it. If it does not, you are entitled to repair, replacement or a refund. This statutory right is separate from any manufacturer warranty.

complaints.title: Complaints and disputes
complaints.body: Report a complaint using the contact details at the bottom of the page; we respond within fourteen days. If we cannot resolve it together, you may turn to the European ODR platform or the Dutch courts. Dutch law applies to this agreement.

privacy.title: Privacy and cookies
privacy.intro: This shop stores as little as possible. Below is exactly what is kept on your device, why, and for how long.
privacy.storageTitle: What we store on your device
privacy.storageIntro: The law makes no distinction between cookies and other browser storage: the same rules apply to localStorage. That is why everything is listed together here.

NEXT_LOCALE.purpose: Remembers whether you view the site in Dutch or English.
NEXT_LOCALE.retention: Until you close your browser (session cookie).

caro-cart.purpose: Your shopping cart: which items you selected and how many.
caro-cart.retention: Until you empty the cart or clear your browser data.

caro-checkout.purpose: The delivery details you enter yourself, so you do not have to retype them.
caro-checkout.retention: Until you clear your browser data.

caro-vehicle.purpose: The car you looked up, so we can show parts that fit it.
caro-vehicle.retention: Until you choose another car or clear your browser data.

theme.purpose: Your choice of light or dark theme.
theme.retention: Until you clear your browser data.

privacy.noBannerTitle: Why you do not see a cookie banner
privacy.noBannerBody: Consent is required for storage that is not needed to make the site work — such as measuring visitor behaviour or advertising. Everything in the table above is either necessary for the shop to function, or a choice you made yourself. A legal exemption applies to that, so we do not have to ask for consent. We also consider it misleading to ask permission for something you cannot refuse without breaking the shopping cart.
privacy.noTracking: We use no analytics, no advertising cookies, no social media buttons and no third-party trackers. The site also loads no fonts or scripts from external servers.
privacy.personalDataBody: As long as you are only browsing, we process no personal data. That changes at two moments:
privacy.personalCheckout: At checkout you enter your name, address, email address and optionally a phone number. We need these to deliver your order and issue an invoice.
privacy.personalPlate: If you enter a licence plate, we send it to the Dutch RDW vehicle database to look up your car. A licence plate is personal data, which is why it never appears in a web address and is not kept in our logs.
privacy.thirdPartiesTitle: Parties that receive data from us
privacy.thirdPartiesBody: We do not sell your data and share it only where needed to fulfil your order:
privacy.thirdTyre24: Tyre24 / ALZURA — our supplier. Receives the details needed to deliver your parcel when you place an order.
privacy.thirdRdw: overheid.io — provides the RDW vehicle data. Receives the licence plate you enter, and nothing else about you.
privacy.thirdHosting: Our hosting provider — processes technical data such as your IP address in order to serve the site.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request which data we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted, and object to the processing. Contact us to do so. If we cannot resolve it together, you can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about your data? Get in touch with:

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.metaDescription: Answers about shipping, payment, returns and choosing parts that fit your car.
faq.intro: Question not answered here? Get in touch using the details at the bottom of this page.

shipping.question: What does shipping cost?
shipping.answer: Shipping within the Netherlands costs {shipping}. From {freeFrom} you pay nothing. We ship with PostNL, DHL or DPD; the final carrier will be announced when the shop opens. We aim to deliver within thirty days and will tell you if that is not going to happen — you can then cancel free of charge.

vat.question: Do prices include VAT?
vat.answer: Yes. Every price on the site includes 21% Dutch VAT, in the cart as well. Shipping costs appear before the final checkout step, so you know the total before you pay.

payment.question: How can I pay?
payment.answer: You pay in advance with one of the methods shown at checkout. Your order ships as soon as the payment arrives. Exactly which methods those will be is announced when the shop opens — we would rather show nothing than a payment method that does not work yet.

returns.question: Can I return a part?
returns.answer: You may cancel your order within fourteen days of receiving it, without giving a reason, and then have another fourteen days to send it back. We refund within fourteen days of your notice. Parts that have been fitted, or whose seal is broken, cannot be taken back. Return postage is yours to pay unless the item arrived wrong or damaged.

defects.question: What if a part is faulty?
defects.answer: Every item has to do what you may reasonably expect of it. If it does not, you are entitled to repair, replacement or a refund. That statutory right is separate from any manufacturer warranty. Report it using the contact details at the bottom of the page; we respond within fourteen days.

condition.question: Are the parts new?
condition.answer: Yes. CarO sells new parts, tyres, wheels and accessories only, and only for passenger cars and two-wheelers. No used parts, and nothing for trucks, agriculture or industry.

fits.question: How do I know a part fits my car?
fits.answer: Enter your registration, or pick make, model and version. We translate that into your car as the parts manufacturers know it, and then show only parts that fit that version. Wheels and accessories work differently: there we search the supplier’s description for make and model. That is a strong indication, not a guarantee — always check the measurements before you order.

plate.question: What do you do with my registration number?
plate.answer: We use it only to look up your car. It never appears in the web address and is not kept in a log file. You can always clear the selected car yourself with the cross in the vehicle bar.

tyreSize.question: Which tyre size do I need?
tyreSize.answer: It is printed on the sidewall of your current tyre, for example 205/55 R16: the width in millimetres, the height as a percentage of that width, and the rim diameter in inches. There is no reliable route from a registration number to a tyre size, so you enter it yourself in the tyre size picker.
